title: An heir's indiscretion
text: A young heir of a Great House is caught somewhere they should not have been, with someone they should not have been with — and the fixer comes to YOU, because you know how to keep a secret.

effects.tpl: Witnesses paid, records misplaced, heir grateful. A house now owes you silence-priced favors. +14 prestige.

then.tpl: The scandal blooms beautifully and your name is nowhere on it. +10 fame, −12 karma.

else.tpl: Traced to your doorstep. The house denies everything and ruins your week. −20 prestige.

effects.tpl: You send the fixer away. Your conscience is clean; the heir is, reportedly, not. +6 karma.
